details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds access in the hpmud DOT4 and MLC
     transports (ELSCVE-271050)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91101.patch (since els1)
     - CVE-2026-91101
   * SECURITY UPDATE: unchecked MFPDTF block length in the hpaio backend
     (ELSCVE-271051)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91103.patch (since els1)
     - CVE-2026-91103
   * SECURITY UPDATE: heap overflow in the hpcups raster line buffer
     (ELSCVE-271046)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91104.patch (since els1)
     - CVE-2026-91104
   * SECURITY UPDATE: buffer overflows in the hpps filter (ELSCVE-271049)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91105.patch (since els1)
     - CVE-2026-91105
   * SECURITY UPDATE: buffer overflows in hpcups, hpijs and the hpaio HTTP
     response reader (ELSCVE-271045)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91106.patch (since els1)
     - CVE-2026-91106
   * SECURITY UPDATE: insecure lock file used by hpssd to start the HP
     plug-in installer (ELSCVE-271048)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91099.patch (since els2)
     - CVE-2026-91099
   * SECURITY UPDATE: lp/lpr argument injection via the file name in hp-print
     (ELSCVE-271047)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-91102.patch (since els2)
     - CVE-2026-91102
   * SECURITY UPDATE: remaining HPLIP 3.26.6 security fixes (advisory
     HPSBPI04151)
     - debian/patches/hplip-3.26.6-security-remainder.patch: bound copies,
       indexes and sizes in libhpmud (pml, hpmud, jd, model, musb), hpijs,
       hp_ipp addCupsPrinter() and the hpaio scan backends; quote the input
       file name in pstotiff; check the user name and create a private fax
       FIFO in the hpfax backend; confine HP plug-in install paths; clean up
       device model names.
     - debian/patches/hplip-3.26.6-pkservice-removal.patch, debian/rules,
       debian/hplip.install, debian/hplip.manpages: remove the root
       hp-pkservice D-Bus service, its D-Bus and polkit files and
       --enable-policykit; non-root HP plug-in installs keep using su/sudo;
       downstream: keep base/pkit.py, which HP's 3.17.10 plug-in installer
       imports.
     - Behaviour change: PC-fax through the hpfax backend now hangs the fax
       queue until the job is cancelled (its FIFO is 0600, owned by lp).
     - Behaviour change: tools run as root (sudo hp-setup in GUI mode,
       hp-toolbox) hang when they need the HP plug-in (hp-plugin waits on a
       terminal nobody answers); run hp-plugin from a terminal instead.
